summary: Schema-directed element decoding works essentially corpus-wide. src/rvt/objects.py walks each record's class field list (parent-first) from the canonical Formats/Latest schema and decodes seq 101/102/103 partition records into nested dicts of real values. racbasic: 85,814/85,814 seq-102 records (306 classes) decode with 100% of body bytes consumed and zero errors; seq 101 (ElementHeader) and seq 103 (GElement / SerializedDummy) also 100%; rac/rst advanced 100%; corpus-wide seq-102 clean rate 99.69% — the ONLY failures anywhere are Extensible-Storage entity blobs (1,171 rme FamilyInstances + 7 rstbasic records). The record class_word→type_id mapping is proven IDENTITY (k=0: 4000/4000 clean; k=±1: <3%), and the framing was corrected/unified: record = i64 id [+u32 stamp] + u32 psize + payload{u16 class_id, object} + u32 psize repeat (trailer verified on 100% of records); one record per element per seq with identical id sets across seqs 101/102/103. Also found and worked around a real bug: partitions.partition_stream_paths() globs the .logical.bin extraction artefact, duplicating/garbling the segment (this created phantom failures earlier).
key_findings: docs/streams/01-schema.md anchor validation PASSED (16/16, id = definition order + 0x0c, no drift); schema.json present (4,690 classes) — schema_a.json fallback not needed.

Record framing corrected: wave-1 'u32 class_word' = u16 class_id (schema type_id, identity mapping) + first u16 of the object; every record ends with a u32 psize repeat (matches for all 85,978 racbasic seq-101 and seq-102 records incl. 164 id=-1 sentinels). Uniform layout: i64 id [+u32 stamp in seq 102/103] + u32 psize + {u16 class_id, object[psize-2]} + u32 psize. SerializedDummy (seq 103) = psize 2 = bare class id with an EMPTY object (placeholder for elements with no geometry rep), not undecodable.

Records are one-per-element-per-seq: racbasic has exactly 85,814 records in each of seq 101/102/103 with identical id sets and no duplicate ids; seq 101 = ElementHeader (0x5e5, incl. m_classDef ClassDefinitionRef = the element's class name), seq 102 = the polymorphic element object, seq 103 = GElement geometry rep (11,863) or SerializedDummy. All 8,401 Global/ElemTable ids are a subset of the partition record ids; Element.m_id == record id for every decoded object.

Field order = parent-first (root base Element's 20 fields, then each subclass down): 4000/4000 clean vs 96/4000 for self-first. Serialization codebook verified: AString = u32 count + UTF-16LE (0xFFFFFFFF = null); GUID 16 raw; ElementId flattened to i64 (-1 invalid); XYZ/UV/Trf = schema fixed double arrays; containers = u32 count + elements; owned/poly pointers = i32 pid (0 null, -1 anonymous, >0 archive object index, already-seen pid = back-reference) + u16 class with the pointed object body DEFERRED breadth-first after the current object's fields; weak pointers = u32 pid (1=document, 2=record root).

Target classes identified and decoding: Level 0x9e7 (elevation = DatumPlane.m_pSurface->Plane.m_origin[2] in feet; racbasic Level 2 = 9.8425 ft = 3.0 m, Roof Line = 19.685 ft, Foundation = -2.6247 ft, names via m_text), walls = SWall 0xf02 < VWall < HostObj (location line = m_pCurveDriver->VWallDriver.m_pCrv GLine origin/dirVec/endParams; length = endParam delta, e.g. 9.84252 ft = 3 m; m_upToLevelId/m_assocLevelId = real Level ids), Grid 0x90e (m_text '1'), views DBViewPlan/Section/3d (m_viewName 'Level 2', 'Longitudinal Section', 'Solar Analysis'), CategoryElem 0x2e1 -> Category (user sub-category m_name + negative BuiltInCategory parent ids), GUIDs (Family.m_famDocGUID/m_contentDocGUID, FamilySurrogate.m_guid = e3e052f8-0156-11d5-9301-0000863f27ad).

rmebasic: 142,174 seq-102 records, 306 classes, 99.18% clean; EVERY MEP/electrical class decodes 100%: RbsElectricalSystem (circuits, e.g. 'PP-1B', rating 20, load classification 'Receptacles', per-phase apparent/true power, m_dVoltage 2238.89 internal = 208 V), ConnectorElem->ConnectorElemDomainElectrical (voltage 120 V, poles, load classification id), RbsVoltageType ('240': 240/250/220 V), RbsDistributionSysType ('120/240 Single', 3 wires), ElectricalSetting (phase names A/B/C, circuit rating 20), PanelScheduleView (153,800-byte view object clean), RbsWireCurve/RbsConduitCurve connector managers, FamilyInstance placements (Trf 3x3 + origin, m_symbolId, host id, ElectricalFamInstDesignPropertyManager space/room ids). Voltage internal unit verified = V / 0.3048^2. In this build circuits are RbsElectricalSystem (0x0d87); ElectricalCircuit (0x0596) never occurs as a record class.

The only decode failures corpus-wide are ESEntity.m_blob (Extensible Storage): the pointer token is i32 pid=-1 + the 16-byte ES schema GUID (same GUID as the entityMap pair key) + entity data serialized per a runtime ES schema, not an archive class. Verified those schema GUIDs appear in the same file's Global/Latest inside the ADocument ES schema table (JSON-like schema text with Forge units, e.g. rme Global__Latest.gz/000.bin +0x327614, rstbasic +0xe931f) — clear resolution path: run this same decoder over Global/Latest ADocument and read the schema table.

BUG found in shared code (documented in docs/inbox/object-decoder.md, worked around in objects.load_segment, not edited): partitions.partition_stream_paths() globs 'Partitions__*.bin' and therefore also loads the de-paged 'Partitions__N.logical.bin' artefact, mis-walking it and appending a garbled duplicate of the segment head (produced phantom duplicate KeynoteTable records and bogus 'AString length' failures at file-specific offsets). partitions.concat_elements() inherits the duplication.

confidence: High. Framing, class_id identity, parent-first order and the primitive/pointer/container codebook are proven by 100% byte-exact full-record decodes across 383k+ records / 300+ classes in five files (any framing or codebook error would break byte alignment). The only unresolved wire encoding is the Extensible-Storage entity blob (0.3% of records, isolated to one field). Semantic labels for a few values (u32 stamp, pid>2 numbering, GElement geometry meaning) remain hypotheses and are marked as such in the doc.
open_questions: ESEntity.m_blob wire format after the schema GUID (Extensible-Storage entity data) — needs the ES schema table from Global/Latest ADocument (its location is verified, its decode is not done).
Meaning of the u32 'stamp' in seq 102/103 record headers (85,799 distinct values in 85,814 racbasic records) — hypothesised per-object stamp/hash.

Do archive pointer indices (pid > 2) or weak refs ever resolve across record boundaries (a document-global object table)? All observed refs so far resolve locally or to pid 1 (document) / 2 (record root).
Geometric semantics of the fully-decoded seq-103 GElement/GNode trees (faces, loops, GFilter nodes) vs the elements' analytic curves — unvalidated against the IFC oracle.
dach-sample-project (128 MB workshared partition) was not run through the decoder this wave — runtime only, but it may exercise classes not present in the five samples.
